notes.title: Hunt V3.0.0.0 new feature
notes.notes: Hunt V3.0.0.0 allow users to select and play first 12 levels using UI. Last 12 levels still need advancing through levels as usual.

notes.title: Hunt 2.0 added Volcanic Island to double the content and grabbable shotgun.
notes.notes: Hunt 2.0 added a complete extreme adventure on the sea Volcanic Island to double the play content and hunt with grabbable gun and bow support. Hunt is the only VR game that can drive and hunt at the same time!

notes.title: Enhance colony animals (such as elephant, panda, bear, tiger, etc.) animation
notes.notes: Enhance colony animals (such as elephants, panda, bear, tiger, sarcosuchus, archelon, Onchopristis) animation

notes.title: Add Support to Grabble Weapon: Bow and Arrow
notes.notes:
Add support to grabble weapon: Bow and Arrow. Flexible switch between First Person Perspective and Third Person Perspective: Grabbing the Bow will switch to First Person Perspective and releasing the Bow will switch back to Third Person Perspective. Every level has default number of arrows to use, extra arrows will be rewarded for every three eggs collected.

Improve visualization of Boat jump.
